documents.title: Local Ollama health and recovery
documents.summary: Diagnose missing, stopped, unhealthy, offline, and healthy local states without network access.
documents.body: The suite manager uses only a local adapter. Offline help remains available when Ollama is missing or stopped.

documents.title: Models and conservative hardware fit
documents.summary: Browse verified local model records and explain Runs well, Runs with limits, Unlikely, or Unknown.
documents.body: Model records are supplied by a verified local source. Missing size or hardware evidence produces Unknown rather than a guess.

documents.title: Batch pulls
documents.summary: Queue local pulls with bounded progress, cancellation, retry, and partial outcomes.
documents.body: A failed item stays failed and never turns the batch green or removes an installed model.

documents.title: Local chat sessions
documents.summary: Stream or complete chat through the local Ollama adapter with editable parameters and saved sessions.
documents.body: Prompts, responses, and attachments remain on this device.

documents.title: Allowlisted harness profiles
documents.summary: Launch only picked executables with explicit argument arrays and reviewable local profiles.
documents.body: Arbitrary shell commands and unvalidated expansion are rejected.
